landing.problemsTitle: Why Medication Routines Become Dangerous for Seniors
landing.problemsSub: Taking multiple pills daily across different doctors and timings can easily lead to accidental overdoses or missed doses.
landing.p1_desc: Different strengths, timings and instructions from multiple doctors pile up without a single clear view.
landing.p2_desc: Each doctor sees one symptom, but not what other doctors have already prescribed, leading to cross-doctor drug conflicts.
landing.p3_desc: Taking an over-the-counter painkiller like Ibuprofen while on blood thinners like Aspirin can cause severe internal bleeding.
landing.p4_desc: Seniors don't know whether to take a forgotten pill immediately, wait, or skip — doubling up is dangerous.
landing.p5_desc: Identical white round pills and tiny packaging text confuse elders. Visual recognition solves this.
landing.p6_desc: Family members cannot easily verify whether elderly parents took their morning blood pressure or evening diabetes medicines.
landing.s1_desc: Take a photo of your prescription or medicine packet. Our AI reads it automatically.
landing.s2_desc: See exactly what your tablet and blister strip look like so you never mix up medicines.
landing.s3_desc: Every new drug is cross-referenced with your active prescriptions for severe bleeding or kidney interactions.
landing.s4_desc: Hear clear voice instructions in Hindi, Marathi, or English at meal and wake times.
landing.s5_desc: Trusted family members receive immediate alerts if two doses are missed in a row.
landing.ctaTitle: Never worry about your parents' medicines again.
landing.ctaSub: Accessible, senior-friendly medication adherence designed for families across India.
landing.footer: MedCheck HealthTech — Patient safety & medication adherence system. Designed for seniors and caregivers.
